notes.title: Pongspin v2.0 | The Lockball Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215843/ffbc843a0b8a2e62f3913a973d6acd0971ec4c61.png[/img]

Pongspin's first major update is here, here are all the cool new things added:

[b][h2]Changes[/h2][/b]
- Added Lockball, it is unlocked after getting three wins in Spin Tennis.
- Added announcer voice (present in Spin Tennis and Lockball), this voice can be toggled on or off in sound settings.
- Added four new achievements.
- Minor UI Changes in Spin Tennis.
- New icons in the game mode selection menu.
- HELL mode now exists as a selectable mode in the game mode selection menu.
- Minor text changes.
- Added Pokeizel

Thanks for playing :)

[previewyoutube=lAiF--wFfUw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dotekicept's website is live!
notes.content:
After a painstaking two days of work, the official Dotekicept website is now up and running!

We have all the basic game developer website necessities: a Pongspin page, an "about us" page, but in addition to those we have started up a new blog for posting development updates, big announcements and our experiences at events!

Our first blog post details our experiences demoing Pongspin at the first annual Game Con Canada, as well as some information regarding Pongspin's upcoming Lockball update!

Check it out at [url=www.dotekicept.com]www.dotekicept.com[/url]!

Thanks for all your support!
